evidence: The panel contains no password field and no credential input at all -- Amazon sign-in is delegated to a separate Chrome window (web/panel.html:1084-1090) -- so there is no non-auth field sitting next to a password field for a password manager to mis-trigger on.

evidence: No `truncate`, `line-clamp`, `break-words`, `word-break`, `overflow-wrap` or `text-overflow` declaration exists in web/panel.html (grep returns nothing), yet several bounded containers render API-supplied text: :346 `<h2 id="deck-name">` holds Anki deck names, which are `::`-joined and frequently unbroken; :1430 queue rows render `esc(q.text.slice(0, 140))`, a 140-character slice that may contain no space; :1276 shelf rows render book titles. evidence: There is no truncation to defeat: grep for `truncate`, `line-clamp` and `text-overflow` across web/panel.html returns nothing, so no flex child anywhere in the interface is relying on min-width:0 to clip its text.

fix:
Add a zero-item branch to loadQueued(): when `!(d.queued || []).length`, render `
Nothing queued yet. What you write above waits here until you want it.
` instead of an empty list.

evidence: The panel is a narrow always-on strip and no surface constrains user text at either extreme: no overflow-wrap/word-break/truncate rule exists anywhere in web/panel.html, and `body { ... overflow: hidden; }` (:25) clips rather than scrolls. At one character, `<h2 id="deck-name">` (:346) and `<h2 id="book-title">` (:374) collapse to a stub beneath their labels; at ten times typical length a single unbroken token (a `::`-chained Anki deck name, a 140-char queued prompt from :1430, a long Notes item from :1325) runs past the panel edge and is cut off.
fix: Apply `overflow-wrap: anywhere` to the text-bearing rules (h2, .why, .mono, ul.todo label) and cap the long end with `line-clamp`/`text-overflow: ellipsis` plus a title attribute carrying the full string.

evidence: web/panel.html:1328-1339 `todoListHtml()` maps every item of every list -- `open.map((it) => todoItemHtml(it))` and `done.map(...)` -- and :1391 renders `d.lists.map(todoListHtml).join('')` for all lists at once, with no virtualization and no `content-visibility: auto` anywhere in the stylesheet. evidence: The only layout reads in web/panel.html are `$('reader').getBoundingClientRect()` inside readerBox() at :803, which is reached from tickReader()/readerRenderBox() (:824, :955-958) on the poll timer and the debounced resize handler (:1625-1629), and `e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()` at :1614 inside a click handler. No render helper (renderCard :527, renderReader :967, renderCompanions :1480, _renderStarCal :1847) reads offsetHeight, offsetWidth, scrollTop or a rect.

No loop in web/panel.html interleaves a layout read with a style write. The DOM loops write only -- :510 `for (const s of document.querySelectorAll('.view')) s.classList.toggle(...)`, :513-515 the aria-current loop, :1702-1707 the displaced-element move loop (which reads parentNode/nextSibling, not geometry). moveTodoItem() at :1342-1349 reads `li.style.paddingLeft`, an inline-style read that does not force layout.

The panel uses no framework and no controlled inputs: the textarea at web/panel.html:461 is uncontrolled, read only on save (`const text = $('box').value.trim();` at :1435), and its only keydown listener (:1557-1559) fires just on Cmd/Ctrl+Enter. The checkbox change handler at :1395-1414 respond to a discrete toggle, not to keystrokes.
